is_finance_content.description: True if the video meaningfully discusses stocks, markets, or investing. False for off-topic content.

tldr.description: 1-2 sentence summary of the video's main argument or content.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, uppercase. e.g. NVDA, BRK.B

stance.description: The speaker's directional stance. Use mentioned_only if no view was expressed.

price_target.description: If the speaker stated a price target.

time_horizon.description: The time horizon for the stance, if stated.

rationale.description: Why the speaker holds this stance, in one sentence.

timestamp.description: mm:ss where this ticker is first discussed.

topics.description: Free-form topic tags. e.g. 'AI infrastructure', 'Fed policy', 'earnings season'.

macro_views.description: Speaker's views on macro factors (rates, inflation, recession) if stated.

overall_sentiment.description: Overall directional sentiment of the speaker for this video.
